 Three mega-sales and the Christmas retail season are left in 2026, and they land in a tight six-week window: 11.11 (Singles' Day) on Wednesday 11 November, Black Friday on 27 November into Cyber Monday on 30 November, 12.12 on Saturday 12 December, with mall and department store Christmas sales filling the gaps to Boxing Day. This guide lays out the confirmed dates, what each sale is historically best for, the voucher-stacking method that decides whether a sale price is actually a sale price, and the traps: inflated before prices, voucher pools that empty in minutes, and 11.11 figures quoted from last year. As of 23 October, no platform has published its 2026 11.11 mechanics yet, so treat any blog quoting voucher amounts as recycling old numbers until Shopee's and Lazada's own pages switch over.
 Sarah Lim 23 October 2026 6 min read Three mega-sales and the whole Christmas retail season are packed into the next six weeks, and the difference between saving real money and buying marked-up "discounts" is mostly preparation. 
 > Quick view: 11.11 Singles' Day, Wed 11 Nov · Black Friday Fri 27 Nov → Cyber Monday Mon 30 Nov · 12.12 Sat 12 Dec · Christmas and Boxing Day sales through 26 Dec · payday voucher drops on the 15th and 25th monthly. As of 23 Oct , no platform has published 2026 11.11 mechanics, so ignore blogs quoting voucher numbers. 
 THE CALENDAR, IN ONE TABLE 
 Date Sale Where Best for 
 Wed 11 Nov 11.11 Singles' Day Shopee, Lazada, Amazon.sg The year's deepest voucher pools; everyday items and local sellers 
 Fri 27 Nov Black Friday All platforms + international retailers Tech, gaming gear, overseas brands 
 Mon 30 Nov Cyber Monday Online, Amazon.sg strongest Electronics round two 
 Sat 12 Dec 12.12 Shopee (birthday sale), Lazada Last mega-drop; gifts before Christmas cutoffs 
 Through 26 Dec Christmas + Boxing Day sales Malls, department stores, brand e-stores Festive sets, fashion, Boxing Day clearance 
 15th + 25th monthly Payday voucher drops Shopee, Lazada Fresh platform and free-shipping pools between sales 
 WHAT IS ACTUALLY CONFIRMED FOR 11.11 (very little, honestly) 
 Only the date. As of 23 October, neither Shopee nor Lazada has published 2026 11.11 mechanics. The pattern from this year's sales: Shopee opened ShopeeVIP early access on the 1st of the sale month for 9.9 and 10.10, and its campaign page switched to the new sale's sneak peek only days before launch, so watch shopee.sg/m/1111 from late October. One trap we keep documenting: Shopee's campaign pages carry the new year in the page title while still showing last year's banners and perks , which is how blogs end up quoting dead voucher figures. If an "11.11 guide" names exact voucher amounts before the platforms do, it is recycling 2025. 
 The 10.10 yardstick for judging 11.11 when it lands: Shopee's 10.10 led with up to $100 off Shopee Live vouchers , $120 off $1,000 at Shopee Mall, 12% coins cashback and free shipping from $15 . If an 11.11 voucher is smaller than its 10.10 equivalent, the bigger sale is not automatically the better deal. 
 HOW TO STACK, SO THE SALE PRICE IS REAL 
 Four layers apply to a single order, plus one on top: 
 Store voucher , claimed on the product page 
 Platform voucher , claimed from the vouchers page before you shop 
 Free-shipping voucher , with thresholds that drop during sales 
 Bank-card promo , often another 10-15% with a minimum spend 
 On top of all four: click through a cashback app right before checkout so the cashback pays on what you actually spend 
 Claim the high-value vouchers at drop time; the big pools empty within minutes. And compare the same item across Shopee, Lazada and Amazon.sg at final checkout price , not by the percentage-off badge, because some "was" prices get raised quietly before mega-sales. 
 THE CHRISTMAS SALES LAYER 
 From late November the physical retail season takes over: department store and mall Christmas promotions, festive gift sets, and the 1-for-1 dining promos that cluster around the holidays, ending in Boxing Day clearances on 26 December , traditionally the year's steepest in-store markdowns on fashion and festive stock. Two practical notes for Christmas shopping online: platform delivery cutoffs for pre-Christmas arrival typically land in early-to-mid December , so 12.12 is realistically the last safe mega-sale for physical gifts; and festive F&B (log cakes, turkeys, hampers) sells on early-bird pricing through November, where the discounts are usually better than anything in Christmas week. 
 WHILE YOU WAIT: codes already live 
 A few dated offers we have verified recently bridge the gap to 11.11: iShopChangi's wine and electronics codes run to 31 October, its beauty code 25BFLYBUY to 11 November, and HSBC40 ($40 off $400, HSBC cards) to 31 December. Our 10.10 wrap-up tracks what carried over. 
 Frequently Asked Questions
 When are the year-end sales in Singapore in 2026? + Four waves. 11.11 Singles' Day lands on Wednesday 11 November across Shopee, Lazada and Amazon.sg, and is historically the biggest sale of the year. Black Friday is Friday 27 November, rolling into Cyber Monday on 30 November, strongest for electronics and overseas brands. 12.12 falls on Saturday 12 December, Shopee's birthday sale and the last mega-drop of the year. Mall and department store Christmas sales then run through late December, ending in Boxing Day clearances on 26 December. Between the mega-sales, Shopee and Lazada drop fresh vouchers around payday on the 15th and 25th of each month.
 Is 11.11 or Black Friday better for buying in Singapore? + Different strengths. 11.11 is the local platforms' flagship: the deepest voucher pools of the year on Shopee and Lazada, best for everyday items, local sellers and stacking. Black Friday and Cyber Monday skew towards tech, gaming gear and overseas brands, with Amazon.sg at its strongest and international retailers shipping to Singapore. Practical rule: price your target item at 11.11 with all vouchers applied; if it is tech or from a US or EU brand, check it again on 27 to 30 November before deciding, and remember 12.12 is the backstop, usually at slightly shallower discounts than 11.11.
